job.title: Principal Consultant
job.description:
AWX is part of the larger PeopleIN Group. PeopleIN is the largest ASX-listed talent solutions company in Australia, New Zealand and Singapore.

As the fastest growing labour hire company in Australia, we have expanded our business to meet the needs of our client partners. Leveraging our 21 years' experience in delivering the right talent at volume and speed, AWX Executive provides permanent and contract recruitment solutions in the white-collar and technical space across Property, Construction, Engineering, Finance, Business Support, FMCG, and many more.

Due to strong business growth and increasing demand from our clients, we are seeking a driven and entrepreneurial Principal Consultant to join our Executive Recruitment team.

This role combines Business Development and Technical Recruitment, sourcing and placing white and blue-collar professionals across construction, trades, manufacturing, government, scientific or other sectors you specialise in—we’re flexible. We are currently across all industries with a diverse group of companies in our Group.

This position, giving you the autonomy to run your own business within our business. You’ll manage the full process from business development through to permanent placement, leveraging our large national client base and strong referral network while actively building new relationships to grow your desk.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, love relationship building, and want to be rewarded with competitive commissions for your results, this is your chance to take the next step in your career. We will not tie you down with corporate red tape or tell you how many phone calls to make a day, we measure results!

Key Responsibilities

  • Source, screen, and place technical and professional candidates across your chosen sectors
  • Manage and nurture long-term relationships with clients and candidates
  • Partner with hiring managers to understand business needs and deliver tailored recruitment solutions
  • Proactively identify new business opportunities and drive growth with speed to market and quality recruitment – we are seeking high value outcomes in this space
  • Facilitate the end-to-end recruitment process with integrity and professionalism – demonstrate the value in your structured professional submissions and most importantly finding those hard to find candidates.

What’s on Offer

  • Competitive commission structure designed to reward high performance
  • Access to a warm client portfolio with live roles ready to fill
  • Tools, resources, and autonomy to build your own vertical and make it your own
  • A supportive, experienced team culture that values collaboration – frequent client relationship sharing between our companies with win win outcomes
  • The opportunity to operate like an entrepreneur while backed by a strong brand and national footprint – supply clients across Australia and NZ
  • We also don’t restrict you to perm and support ability to deliver high margin temp services to compliment your perm earning power

What You’ll Bring

  • Proven recruitment experience (perm) ideally within construction, trades, industrial, or other sectors but we are flexible to all industry backgrounds
  • Proven track record in building a client portfolio and sourcing candidates through headhunting in a competitive market – show us how you get candidates and clients to follow you through your positive relationships you consistently build!
  • Strong business development and relationship management skills – we want long term clients, not transactional supply
  • A proactive, results-driven attitude with an entrepreneurial mindset
  • Ability to multi-task and deliver strong outcomes quickly
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills
  • A genuine focus on candidate care and building deep client relationships
  • Ability to work autonomously while being part of a collaborative team
  • FUN! Enjoy what you do and thrive on the thrill of the wins

If you are motivated to build a successful perm desk, partner with leading clients, and run your own business within ours, we would love to hear from you. APPLY NOW!

job.title: HR/ER Advisor
job.description:
Regional Workforce Management (RWM) powered by PeopleIN - Australia's largest family of workforce solutions and recruitment brands.

RWM is proudly Australian-owned, dedicated to connecting businesses with tailored recruitment and workforce management solutions since 2000. Formerly FIP Group, we’ve spent over two decades supporting the backbone of Australia - the food, agriculture, forestry and fisheries industries. By blending local expertise with a national reach, we deliver reliable and committed people who help businesses grow, thrive and stand strong.

Partnering with our onsite teams, the HR/ER Advisor will be responsible for coordinating on site employee relations issues and ensuring compliance with Australian employment laws and regulations. You will provide advice to stakeholders and have an understanding of the Fair Work Act 2009 as well as some exposure to investigating and responding to incidents.

This role will involve working closely with management and employees to address workplace concerns, mediate disputes, and help implement policies that promote a positive work culture.

  • Establish strong relationships with business leaders and managers to understand their needs and challenges.
  • Manage and support a variety of ER cases, including disciplinary actions, grievances, and performance management issues, from initiation to resolution.
  • Conduct thorough and impartial investigations into employee complaints and incidents.
  • Support managers in handling performance management issues.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed case documentation, ensuring accuracy and confidentiality.

What you will need

  • Tertiary qualified in Human Resource Management or similar field (highly regarded but not essential)
  • Previous experience (1-2 years) in a HR or equivalent role.
  • Knowledge of or ability to find applicable legislation, industrial relations instruments, frameworks and best practice.
  • Ability to interpret legislation, policies and other industrial instruments.
  • Sound knowledge of the statutory and regulatory framework in which employee relations operates.
  • Strong judgement and decision-making skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and verbal communication skills.

If this sounds like an opportunity that excites you, we want to hear from you. APPLY NOW!

job.description:

We are PeopleIN - Australia’s largest ASX listed family of staffing brands.

Vision Surveys (QLD) has been operating in Queensland for over a decade, with the three Directors having a combined local presence of over 50 years. Due to continued success and growth, we are seeking a Planner to join the team in Brisabne. We are looking for a qualified and experienced Town Planner to join a small but efficient planning team.   • Ability to work in a team environment and co-ordinate with internal and external project team members
  • Familiar with land use, design, economic, environmental, and infrastructure issues in Queensland

  • Effective time management skills
  • Excellent and creative problem-solving skills

Why Join Vision Surveys?

  • Work on diverse projects across residential, industrial, and commercial sectors.
  • Collaborate closely with an in-house team of surveyors and designers.
  • Take ownership of projects from concept to approval.
  • Be part of a forward-thinking team that values innovation and growth.

To be successful in this role you will be dedicated and driven, with the ability to think outside the box.

  • Be persistent, perseverant, and positive to achieve the desired outcome
  • Have experience in customer service
  • Have a "can do" attitude and work well as part of a team

job.title: Surveyors - Australia
job.description:
Vision Surveys is looking for experienced Construction Surveyors from New Zealand who are ready for their next adventure in Australia. With opportunities across Brisbane, Gold Coast, Rockhampton, Gladstone and Airlie Beach, you can choose a location that suits your lifestyle while working on great projects with a team of good humans.

Who We Are
Vision Surveys (QLD) has been operating in Queensland for over a decade, with our three Directors bringing more than 50 years of combined local experience.
We provide comprehensive Mining, Engineering and Cadastral Land Surveying and Town Planning services across Queensland. We’re big on culture, good people and creating a workplace where you actually enjoy turning up to work.

The Opportunity
We’re looking for Construction Surveyors currently based in New Zealand who are interested in relocating to Queensland and joining the Vision Surveys team.
Opportunities are available across: Brisbane, Gold Coast, Rockhampton, Gladstone and Airlie Beach. Roster options include Monday to Friday or 2 weeks on 1 week off roster.

Whether you're chasing the city lifestyle, coastal living or somewhere a little more relaxed, we have opportunities across some awesome Queensland locations.

There are a range of large construction, civil, infrastructure and major projects, wind farm and main roads projects with plenty of variety and opportunities to grow.

What’s On Offer

  • Relocation allowance to help you make the move from New Zealand to Australia
  • Excellent pay rates
  • Great projects across Queensland
  • Vision Vehicle
  • Phone allowance
  • Multiple Queensland locations to choose from
  • Supportive and down-to-earth team
  • Plenty of work and opportunities for development
  • The chance to make the move to sunny Queensland and enjoy a new lifestyle


Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct field surveys, site measurements and data collection
  • Prepare survey plans, reports and spatial data outputs
  • Operate surveying instruments including GPS, total stations and digital levels
  • Ensure accuracy and compliance with project specifications and safety requirements
  • Liaise with clients, engineers, site managers and internal teams
  • Manage project documentation and maintain accurate records
  • Report to and communicate with the Survey Manager


What We’re Looking For

  • Leica or Trimble surveying equipment
  • Experience with surveying software such as 12d, Magnet or AutoCAD is advantageous
  • Degree or Diploma in Surveying or a related discipline
  • Previous experience working as a Surveyor or in a similar surveying role
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Strong communication and organisational skills
  • Current open driver’s licence

Ready for a Sea Change? If you’ve been thinking about making the move from New Zealand to Australia, this could be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.
Come work on great projects, earn good rates and enjoy the Queensland lifestyle with opportunities across Brisbane, Gold Coast, Rockhampton, Gladstone and Airlie Beach.

Ready to make the move? APPLY NOW!
